## Project Summary

A complete React-based frontend application for company data management with advanced features:

### Features Implemented
- Advanced company filtering (industry, location, status, employees, revenue)
- Real-time search functionality
- Responsive table/card layout for different screen sizes
- Detailed company profile modals
- Pagination with customizable items per page
- Sorting capabilities for all data columns
- Modern Material-UI design
- TypeScript for type safety
- Context API for state management

### Technology Stack
- React 19.2.0 with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- Material-UI for UI components
- React Context API for state management
- Mock data API simulation

### Development Server
The application is running at http://localhost:5174/ with hot reload enabled.
